meta.name: add-whatsapp
meta.description: Add WhatsApp channel via native Baileys adapter. Direct connection — no Chat SDK bridge. Uses QR code or pairing code for authentication.

copy.tagline: 接入 WhatsApp 渠道,直接收发消息
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在开发需要与 WhatsApp 收发消息的应用或机器人.
copy.tagline_en: Connect WhatsApp channel for direct messaging
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building an app or bot that needs to send and receive WhatsApp messages.

howto.what: 装上后,NanoClaw 可以接入 WhatsApp 收发消息。首次连接要用手机扫二维码或输入配对码验证;它会先确认你用的是「专用号码」还是「日常共享号码」——共享号码只在你自己的对话里回复、不读别人消息,回复会带助手名前缀。
howto.when: 当你说要给 NanoClaw 添加或接入 WhatsApp 频道时触发。安装过程中,只要你提到「共享」「个人」「日常」等字眼,它会直接按共享号码处理并先显示账号风险警告。

say.text: 给 NanoClaw 添加 WhatsApp 频道

say.note: 走配对码方式,并填入该号码。

say.text: 用我平时用的号码继续安装
say.note: 会先显示账号风险警告并让你确认。

howto.what_en: NanoClaw can then chat over WhatsApp. One-time link via QR code or 8-character pairing code. It checks dedicated vs shared number: on shared, it only replies in your self-chat, ignores others, prefixes replies with the assistant name.
howto.when_en: When you ask to add or connect a WhatsApp channel to NanoClaw. During setup, if you mention "shared", "personal", or "everyday", it treats the number as shared and shows the account-risk warning first.

say_en.text: Add a WhatsApp channel to NanoClaw.
say_en.note: Starts the install and setup flow.

say_en.text: Link with a pairing code; my number is 14155551234.
say_en.note: Uses the pairing-code method with that number.

say_en.text: Continue with the number I use every day.
say_en.note: Shows the account-risk warning first and asks you to confirm.
